questions.question: A is the brother of B. C is the sister of B. D is the father of C. How is D related to A?
questions.explanation: C and B are siblings, A is also B's sibling, and D is the father of C; therefore D is the father of A.

questions.question: Choose the address that is exactly the same as: No. 44, Hillcrest Villas, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh-171001

options.B: No. 44, Hillcrest Villa, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh-171001
options.C: No. 44, Hillcrest Villas, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh-171011
options.D: No. 44, Hillcrest Villas, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh-171001

questions.explanation: Match every word, comma, state name and PIN code. Only the correct option repeats the address exactly.

questions.question: Identify the relation between the two statements. Statement I: The bank's net profit increased significantly in the last quarter. Statement II: The bank implemented cost-cutting measures and improved loan recovery.

options.C: II is the cause and I is the effect.
options.D: I is the cause and II is the effect.

questions.explanation: Cost reduction and better recovery can directly lead to higher profit, so Statement II is the cause.

questions.question: The following equation is incorrect. Which two signs should be interchanged to make it correct? 18 + 6 x 4 - 12 / 3 = 17
questions.explanation: Interchanging - and / gives 18 + 6 x 4 / 12 - 3 = 18 + 2 - 3 = 17.

questions.question: Statements: J > K = L, M >= N < K, O < J < P, N > Q > R. Conclusions: I. P > M II. N < P. Which conclusion is true?

options.C: Both conclusions I and II are true
options.D: Neither conclusion I nor II is true

questions.explanation: N < K = L < J < P, so N < P is definite. M may be greater than P, so P > M is not definite.

questions.question: Select the letter-cluster that will replace the question mark in the series: BEK, DGM, FIO, HKQ, ?
questions.explanation: Each position moves forward by two letters: B-D-F-H-J, E-G-I-K-M, K-M-O-Q-S.

questions.question: What comes next in the series: 3, 6, 18, 108, ?
questions.explanation: The multipliers are 2, 3, 6, so the next multiplier is 12. 108 x 12 = 1296.

questions.question: What will come in place of the question mark? 5, 9, 17, 33, 65, ?
questions.explanation: The differences double each time: +4, +8, +16, +32, +64.

questions.question: Arrange the words as they would appear in an English dictionary: 1. Warriors 2. Warehouse 3. Warcraft 4. Warranty 5. Wardrobe 6. Wardenship
questions.explanation: Compare letter by letter: Warcraft, Wardenship, Wardrobe, Warehouse, Warranty, Warriors.

questions.question: Statements: Some desks are trays. Some trays are plates. Some plates are desks. Conclusions: I. All desks are plates. II. All plates are desks. III. Some plates are trays. IV. All trays are desks. Which conclusion follows?
questions.explanation: Some trays are plates means some plates are trays. The universal conclusions are not definite.

questions.question: In a certain code language, NAME is written as FNBO and NANO is written as POBO. How will NAIL be written in that language?
questions.explanation: The code follows position-wise letter movement seen in the given examples; applying the same pattern to NAIL gives MJBO.

questions.question: Select the option related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. Skin : Touch :: Nose : ?
questions.explanation: Skin is associated with the sense of touch; nose is associated with the sense of smell.

questions.question: In three of the following number-pairs, the second number is obtained by applying the same operation to the first number. Select the odd pair.
questions.explanation: In the regular pairs, second number = first number / 2 + 1. For 15, this gives 8.5, not 9.

questions.question: Amit, Gaurav, Hatim, Varun, Yukti and Zaid are sitting in a straight line, all facing north. Yukti is at one end. Hatim is fourth to the left of Yukti. Gaurav is immediately right of Hatim. Zaid is third to the right of Gaurav. Who sits second to the left of Zaid?
questions.explanation: A valid order is Hatim, Gaurav, Amit, Zaid, Varun, Yukti. The second person to the left of Zaid is Gaurav.

questions.question: If A @ B means A + B, A # B means A x B, A $ B means A - B and A % B means A / B, find the value of 24 % 6 # 5 @ 7 $ 3.
Select the odd word from the given alternatives.
questions.explanation: Badminton, table tennis and tennis use racquets; cricket does not.

questions.question: Rita is 12th from the top and 18th from the bottom in a class. How many students are there in the class?
questions.explanation: Total students = 12 + 18 - 1 = 29.

questions.question: If 1 January of a leap year is Monday, what day will 1 March of the same year be?
questions.explanation: January has 31 days and February has 29 days, total 60 days. 60 mod 7 = 4, so Monday + 4 = Friday.

questions.question: In a group of 80 candidates, 45 study Quant, 38 study Reasoning and 20 study both. How many study neither Quant nor Reasoning?
questions.explanation: At least one = 45 + 38 - 20 = 63. Neither = 80 - 63 = 17.

questions.question: Which of the following words can be formed using the letters of the word ADMINISTRATION?
questions.explanation: MINISTER can be formed from the available letters. The other options need unavailable or extra letters.

questions.question: Statement: All honest officers are respected. Some respected people are strict. Conclusion I: Some strict people are honest officers. Conclusion II: Some honest officers are respected. Which conclusion follows?
questions.explanation: All honest officers are respected, so some honest officers are respected. No definite link between strict people and honest officers is given.

questions.question: If BANK is coded as CBOL, then LOAN will be coded as:
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted one place forward in the alphabet.

questions.question: Find the missing term: DCB, HGF, ?, PON
questions.explanation: Each term has three consecutive letters in reverse order, and the starting letters move D, H, L, P.

questions.question: Which option contains the exact hidden sequence P9L without changing the order?
questions.explanation: P9L appears together and in the same order only in KMP9LQ.

questions.question: 31 is related to 152 and 47 is related to 168 by the same logic. Which number is 66 related to?
questions.explanation: The supplied relation follows the same whole-number operation pattern used in recent SSC analogy questions; applying it to 66 gives 187.

questions.question: In which year was Project Tiger launched in India?
questions.explanation: Project Tiger was launched in 1973 to conserve tiger populations in India.

questions.question: Lathmar Holi is primarily celebrated in which state?
questions.explanation: Lathmar Holi is especially associated with Barsana and Nandgaon in Uttar Pradesh.

questions.question: The Girnar inscription recording the repairs of Sudarshana Lake is associated with which Shaka ruler?
questions.explanation: The Junagadh/Girnar inscription of Rudradaman I mentions the Sudarshana Lake.

questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India deals with writ jurisdiction of High Courts, similar in spirit to Article 32?
questions.explanation: Article 226 empowers High Courts to issue writs.

questions.question: Who is the administrative head of the Indian Audit and Accounts Department?

options.B: Comptroller and Auditor General of India

questions.explanation: The CAG heads the Indian Audit and Accounts Department.

questions.question: The consumption of fixed capital in national income accounting is also called:
questions.explanation: Consumption of fixed capital refers to depreciation of fixed assets.

questions.question: The ancient name of the river Jhelum was:
questions.explanation: In ancient texts, Jhelum is known as Vitasta.

questions.question: In Chola administration, the assembly of Brahmana villages was called:
questions.explanation: Sabha was the assembly in Brahmadeya villages under the Cholas.

questions.question: Which coolant is used for the superconducting magnets of the Large Hadron Collider?
questions.explanation: The LHC uses liquid helium to maintain extremely low temperatures.

questions.question: The term 'sector' is specifically associated with which athletics event?
questions.explanation: Throws such as javelin are measured within a throwing sector.

questions.question: Which award did Pandit Vishwa Mohan Bhatt win in 1994?
questions.explanation: Vishwa Mohan Bhatt won a Grammy in 1994 for 'A Meeting by the River'.

questions.question: A monoecious plant is one in which:

options.B: male and female reproductive structures occur on the same plant

questions.explanation: Monoecious plants bear male and female reproductive structures on the same individual plant.

questions.question: MFIN is associated with which sector in India?
questions.explanation: Microfinance Institutions Network works for development and self-regulation of the microfinance sector.

questions.question: The pH value of a neutral solution at 25 C is:
questions.explanation: A neutral solution has pH 7 at 25 C.

questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian states?
questions.explanation: It passes through eight Indian states.

questions.question: Who is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: The Vice President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: One-rupee currency notes in India are signed by the:
questions.explanation: One-rupee notes are issued by the Government of India and signed by the Finance Secretary.

questions.question: The slogan 'Do or Die' is associated with which movement?
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi gave the 'Do or Die' call during the Quit India Movement in 1942.

questions.question: Hemoglobin contains which metal?
questions.explanation: Hemoglobin contains iron, which helps transport oxygen.

questions.question: The Sundarbans delta is mainly formed by which river system?
questions.explanation: The Sundarbans is part of the Ganga-Brahmaputra delta.

questions.question: Sattriya is a classical dance form associated with which state?
questions.explanation: Sattriya originated in Assam.

questions.question: Photosynthesis releases which gas?
questions.explanation: Oxygen is released during photosynthesis.

questions.question: Kharif crops are generally sown in India during the:
questions.explanation: Kharif crops are sown with the onset of monsoon.

questions.question: GST was introduced in India on:
questions.explanation: GST came into effect in India on 1 July 2017.

questions.question: PM-ABHIM is primarily related to strengthening which sector?
questions.explanation: PM-Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission focuses on health infrastructure.

questions.question: A grocer professes to sell rice at cost price but uses a fake weight of 870 g for 1 kg. Find his profit percentage, correct to two decimal places.
Find the value of cos^2 29 degrees + cos^2 61 degrees.
questions.explanation: cos(90 - A) = sin A, so cos^2 A + sin^2 A = 1.

questions.question: In a circular race of 840 m, A and B start together in the same direction at speeds of 7 m/s and 14 m/s. After how many seconds will they meet again?
questions.explanation: They meet when the faster runner gains one full lap. Time = track / relative speed.

questions.question: Given W : X = 5 : 6, X : Y = 3 : 7 and Y : Z = 8 : 9, find W : X : Y : Z.
questions.explanation: Make the common terms equal: X = 24 and Y = 56, giving W : X : Y : Z = 20 : 24 : 56 : 63.

questions.question: The marked price of mustard oil is 25% more than its cost price. At what percentage less than the marked price should it be sold to have no profit and no loss?
questions.explanation: If CP = 100, MP = 125. Required discount = 25/125 x 100 = 20%.

questions.question: A can complete a work in 25 days and B in 30 days. They work on alternate days starting with A for 5 days, then A leaves. In how many more days will B finish the remaining work?
questions.explanation: Work done in first 5 days = 3/25 + 2/30 = 14/75. Remaining work = 61/75. B takes (61/75) x 30 = 24 2/5 days.

questions.question: A person travels 120 km at 80 km/h, then 100 km at 40 km/h, and returns to the starting point at 75 km/h. Find the approximate average speed for the whole journey.
questions.explanation: Total distance = 440 km. Total time = 120/80 + 100/40 + 220/75 hours. Average speed is about 63.46 km/h.

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 10000 is lent in two parts, one at 7% simple interest and the other at 12% simple interest. If the annual interest is Rs. 900, find the sum lent at 12%.
If a + b = 5 and ab = 6, find a^3 + b^3.

Pipe A can fill a tank in 16 minutes and pipe B in 24 minutes. Both are opened together, but after 4 minutes A's rate doubles and B's rate becomes half. How many more minutes are required to fill the tank?
questions.explanation: First 4 minutes fill 5/12 of the tank. New combined rate is 1/8 + 1/48 = 7/48, so remaining 7/12 takes 4 minutes.

questions.question: A hollow metallic sphere has outer radius 10 cm and is melted to make 50 smaller solid spheres of radius 2 cm. Find the inner radius of the original sphere, approximately.
questions.explanation: Volume of metal = 50 x 2^3 units of sphere volume factor. Thus 10^3 - r^3 = 400, so r = cube root of 600 = 8.43 cm approximately.

questions.question: In History, maximum marks are 175. Ram, Mohan and Shyam scored 54%, 51% and 75% respectively. If the passing mark is 105, how many students passed?
questions.explanation: Only Shyam scored 75% of 175 = 131.25, which is at least 105.

questions.question: Two concentric circles have radii 10 cm and 6 cm. Find the length of the chord of the larger circle that touches the smaller circle.
questions.explanation: The perpendicular distance from the centre to the chord is 6 cm. Half chord = sqrt(10^2 - 6^2) = 8 cm, so chord = 16 cm.

questions.question: A invests Rs. 8000 for 12 months, B invests Rs. 12000 for 8 months and C invests Rs. 16000 for 6 months. If total profit is Rs. 60000, find B's share.
questions.explanation: Their capital-time products are equal: 96000 each. Profit is divided equally.

questions.question: Which of the following divides 6^25 + 6^26 + 6^27 + 6^28?
If A is 95% of B, then what percent of A is B?
A train 180 m long crosses a platform 120 m long at 54 km/h. Find the time taken.
questions.explanation: Total distance = 300 m. Speed = 54 x 5/18 = 15 m/s. Time = 300/15 = 20 seconds.

questions.question: A vessel contains 40 litres of milk and water in the ratio 7 : 3. How much water should be added so that milk becomes 50% of the mixture?
questions.explanation: Milk = 28 litres. For milk to be 50%, total mixture must be 56 litres. Add 16 litres water.

questions.question: A flagpole casts a shadow of 10 m. If the height of the flagpole is 10 sqrt(3) m, find the angle of elevation of the sun.
questions.explanation: tan theta = height/shadow = sqrt(3), so theta = 60 degrees.

questions.question: The HCF and LCM of two numbers are 12 and 420 respectively. If one number is 84, find the other number.
questions.explanation: Product of numbers = HCF x LCM. Other number = 12 x 420 / 84 = 60.

questions.question: If x + 1/x = 3, find x^2 + 1/x^2.
questions.explanation: Square both sides: x^2 + 1/x^2 + 2 = 9, so x^2 + 1/x^2 = 7.

questions.question: Which statement is sufficient to conclude that two triangles are congruent?

options.A: They have two equal sides and the same perimeter.
options.B: One side and one angle are equal.
options.C: They have the same area and same base.
options.D: They have the same base and same height.

questions.explanation: If two sides are equal and perimeters are equal, the third side is also equal; hence SSS congruence applies.

questions.question: A table classifies 100 students by aggregate marks: 40 and above = 72, 30 and above = 77, 20 and above = 87, 10 and above = 100. How many scored less than 20 marks?
questions.explanation: Students below 20 = total students - students scoring 20 and above = 100 - 87 = 13.

questions.question: Using pi = 22/7, find the curved surface area of a cylinder of radius 7 cm and height 10 cm.
questions.explanation: Curved surface area = 2 pi rh = 2 x 22/7 x 7 x 10 = 440 sq cm.

questions.question: Simplify: (3 + sqrt(3))^2 - (3 - sqrt(3))^2.
questions.explanation: Use (a+b)^2 - (a-b)^2 = 4ab. Here 4 x 3 x sqrt(3) = 12 sqrt(3).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: LUMINOUS
questions.explanation: Luminous means giving off light; radiant is the closest synonym.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: FATAL
questions.explanation: Fatal means causing death; deadly has the same sense.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: ABROGATE
questions.explanation: Abrogate means to repeal or cancel; uphold means to maintain.

questions.question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: To chew the cud of reflection
questions.explanation: The idiom means to think deeply over something.

questions.question: Identify the segment that contains an error: Neetu have been / waiting for me / since 10 o'clock / in the morning.
questions.explanation: The singular subject Neetu requires 'has been'.

questions.question: Find the correctly spelt word that means the quality of being sarcastic in a bitter way.
questions.explanation: Causticity is the correctly spelt noun form.

questions.question: Choose the correct one-word substitute: A person who supports change.
questions.explanation: A reformer supports improvement or change in a system.

questions.question: Choose the correct one-word substitute: Extremely old-fashioned; belonging to a time before the biblical flood.
questions.explanation: Antediluvian means very old or extremely old-fashioned.

questions.question: Choose the correct option: The anthropologist's findings were considered so controversial that they were initially _______.
questions.explanation: Controversial findings are likely to be disregarded initially.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the sentence in passive voice: Ishika saw the tiger in the forest.

options.A: The tiger sees Ishika in the forest.
options.B: The tiger was seen by the forest in Ishika.
options.C: The tiger was seen by Ishika in the forest.
options.D: The tiger saw by Ishika in the forest.

questions.explanation: Simple past active changes to 'was/were + past participle' in passive voice.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the sentence in active voice: Lovely tunes are composed by Domnica.
questions.explanation: Present simple passive becomes present simple active: Domnica composes lovely tunes.

questions.question: Select the word which means the same as: Unit of weight for precious stones.
questions.explanation: Carat is a unit used for weighing gemstones.

questions.question: Select the one-word substitute: A person who likes to argue about anything.
questions.explanation: Contentious describes a person likely to argue or cause disagreement.

questions.question: Select the best correction: She has been studying for two o'clock.

options.B: She has studying from two o'clock.
options.C: She has been studying since two o'clock.
options.D: She is studying for two o'clock.

questions.explanation: Use 'since' for a point of time.

questions.question: Identify the error: Mr. Abhilash and his family / have received / no informations / about the incident.
questions.explanation: Information is uncountable; use 'no information'.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.

options.A: The participants of the competition are waiting for their turn curiously.
options.B: The participants of the competition has been waiting for their turn curiously.
options.C: A participants of the competition is waiting for their turn curiously.
options.D: The participants of the competition is waiting for their turn curiously.

questions.explanation: The plural subject 'participants' takes the plural verb 'are'.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate antonym of SERVILE.
questions.explanation: Servile means excessively submissive; assertive is opposite in sense.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of EXIGUOUS.
questions.explanation: Exiguous means very small or meagre.

questions.question: Choose the correct indirect speech: The teacher said, 'Submit your notebooks tomorrow.'

options.A: The teacher said submit your notebooks tomorrow.
options.B: The teacher told that submit notebooks tomorrow.
options.C: The teacher asked that notebooks submit the next day.
options.D: The teacher told the students to submit their notebooks the next day.

questions.explanation: A command in direct speech changes to 'told + object + to + verb'; tomorrow becomes the next day.

questions.question: Arrange the sentences in a logical order: (a) Then revisions are made after discussions. (b) First, a basic framework is proposed. (c) Finally, execution begins as per plan. (d) The blueprint is finalised after approval from stakeholders.
questions.explanation: A project normally moves from proposal to revisions, approval/final blueprint, and then execution.

questions.question: Choose the best word for the blank: Predictions sometimes fail; ________, warning signs should not be ignored.
questions.explanation: However introduces contrast between failed predictions and useful warning signs.

questions.question: Choose the best word for the blank: Experts try to ________ future risks from available data.
questions.explanation: Foresee means to predict or anticipate.

questions.question: Choose the best word for the blank: Some forecasts fail. ________, several successful predictions have saved lives.
questions.explanation: Moreover adds another supporting point.

questions.question: Select the incorrectly spelt word: evacuating, assigned, apprentices, glitering
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'glittering'.

questions.question: Find the segment that contains an error: Rarely had the court encountered a petition / so devoid of legal merit, nor so conspicuously intended / to attract media attention rather than judicial remedy. / No error

options.A: to attract media attention rather than judicial remedy.
options.C: so devoid of legal merit, nor so conspicuously intended
options.D: Rarely had the court encountered a petition

questions.explanation: The structure requires a parallel comparative expression; the segment with 'nor so' is faulty in this context.
